# Test pe diff regression gates against JSON and JSONL result fixtures.

! pe diff --fail-on-regression baseline.json current.jsonl
stdout 'Gate: fail'
stdout 'pass rate dropped 50.00 percentage points'
stdout 'average score dropped 0.5000'
stdout 'average latency increased 50.00 ms'
stdout 'failures increased \+1'

pe diff --fail-on-regression --max-pass-rate-drop 60 --max-score-drop 0.6 --max-latency-increase-ms 60 --max-failure-increase 1 baseline.json current.jsonl
stdout 'Gate: pass'

pe diff --format json --fail-on-regression --max-pass-rate-drop 60 --max-score-drop 0.6 --max-latency-increase-ms 60 --max-failure-increase 1 baseline.json current.jsonl
stdout '"passed": true'

pe diff --statistical baseline.json current.jsonl
stdout 'Statistical significance:'
stdout 'Pass rate:'
stdout 'Score:'
stdout 'Latency:'
stdout 'Comparing multiple metrics increases the risk of false positives'

-- baseline.json --
[
  {"id":"base-1","provider":{"id":"mock"},"success":true,"score":1,"latencyMs":100,"response":{"tokenUsage":{"total":10}}},
  {"id":"base-2","provider":{"id":"mock"},"success":true,"score":1,"latencyMs":100,"response":{"tokenUsage":{"total":10}}}
]

-- current.jsonl --
{"id":"current-1","provider":{"id":"mock"},"success":true,"score":1,"latencyMs":120,"response":{"tokenUsage":{"total":10}}}
{"id":"current-2","provider":{"id":"mock"},"success":false,"score":0,"latencyMs":180,"response":{"tokenUsage":{"total":10}}}
